'''Galdos Stouff''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after he [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|tracked]] a [[Jango Fett/Legends|bounty hunter]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Stouff and the Padawan's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[swordmaster]] [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], were part of a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] assembled by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to rescue Kenobi. Stouff, like many fellow Jedi, was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|ensuing battle]].

==Biography==
[[File:Sora_bulq.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Sora Bulq, Stouff's Master]]
A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Galdos Stouff was selected to be the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], a gifted [[Swordmaster|swordsman]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fighting]] instructor.<ref name="Databank: Sora Bulq" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> separatist forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captured [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after he [[Dogfight over Geonosis/Legends|tracked]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to the<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assembled a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|strike team]] of 200 Jedi to rescue Kenobi from the Separatists. Stouff and Bulq were part of the team that infiltrated the [[Petranaki arena]] on Geonosis, where Kenobi was being held.<ref name="ITWOSW" />

The Jedi task force faced numerous [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warriors]] and Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as the ensuing [[Lightfight|fight]] turned into a [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|full-scale battle]]. Though Bulq and Stouff incapacitated a dozen guards on the arena's tribune,<ref name="ITWOSW" /> the number of adversaries overwhelmed the Jedi, and many were [[Death/Legends|killed]], including Stouff. In the engagement's aftermath, Bulq was listed as a casualty of the battle, but he ultimately survived. The loss of Stouff and many other of his former students on Geonosis<ref name="Databank: Sora Bulq" /> eventually led Bulq to fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and he subsequently joined the Separatists.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sensitive to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="ITWOSW" /> Stouff was chosen as a Padawan learner by the Jedi Master Sora Bulq.<ref name="Databank: Sora Bulq" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galdos Stouff was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a [[2003]] reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="ITWOSW" />
